  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****

  COVID- 19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

  Due to the existing COVID - 19 health emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to Assembly Bill 361, please note that members of the public will be allowed only to observe and address the City Council Meeting of November 23, 2021, at 2:00 p.m. (or 1:00 p.m. if Closed Session) by telephone, video and other electronic means, as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, City Clerk staff will check and print emails prior to arriving in the Council Chambers. In the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310- 412- 5280 with any questions.

  2.  Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  >  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable provider for details.

  >  Live online through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video, at https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/

  >  The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to both observe and listen to the meeting.

  3.  Members of the public who wish to address the City Council orally must use the public access option noted below:

  >  Members of the public may listen and make oral public comments telephonically by dialing:

  •  Dial- in for Open Session: 1 -888 - 251 - 2949 or 215- 861 -0694 , using the specific access codes detailed below for the respective City Council Dates:

  o  November 23, 2021 –Access Code: 9308768#

  ACCESSIBILITY : If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability- related modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, or service by contacting the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310- 412- 5280, FAX at 310- 412 -5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.

Inglewood, California
  November 23, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
  November 23, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
  hour of 2:03 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager/CFO
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agendas.

  Marvin McCoy, commented on Agenda Item Nos. 3, Purchase order to May Tool, Inc.
  for the purchase of a portable generator, and 4, Adoption of a resolution amending the
  Fiscal Year 2021-2022 Annual Budget for the Purchase of Mobile Date Computers and
  Related Items.

  Caller (Name Unknown) commented on Agenda Item No. 2, Acceptance and approval of
  the recommendation of the Chief of Police pertaining to the expenditure of Fiscal Year
  2021 Justice Assistance Grant funds.

  Gil Mathieu spoke regarding the Inglewood Police Department and suggested purchasing
  cameras to ensure the safety of everyone.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Faulk that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  November 19, 2021, in the amount of $7,554,785.51 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.
   November 23, 2021

178  REPORT PERTAINING TO THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF
  JUSTICE FISCAL YEAR 2021 BYRNE MEMORIAL JUSTICE ASSISTANCE
  GRANT REPORT - RECEIVED AND FILED; CERTIFICATIONS AND
  ASSURANCES FOR THE ACCEPTANCE OF FISCAL YEAR 2021 JUSTICE
  ASSISTANCE GRANT FUNDS - APPROVED; EXPENDITURES OF FISCAL
  YEAR 2021 JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT FUNDS - AUTHORIZED;
  RESOLUTION NO. 22-17 ADOPTED – ACCEPTANCE OF GRANT FUNDS
  FROM THE JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT PROGRAM. Staff report dated
  November 23, 2021, was presented recommending acceptance and approval of the
  recommendation of the Chief of Police pertaining to the expenditure of Fiscal Year 2021
  Justice Assistance Grant funds.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Receive and file this report pertaining to the United
  States Department of Justice Fiscal Year 2021 Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant;
  2) Approve Certifications and Assurances required for acceptance of Fiscal Year 2021
  Justice Assistance Grant funds; 3) Authorize the expenditures of Fiscal Year 2021 Justice
  Assistance Grant funds in the amount of $53,579 for the approved recommendation; and
  4) Adopt Resolution No. 22-17 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE OF GRANT FUNDS
  FROM JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT PROGRAM IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $53,579

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

178  PURCHASE ORDER APPROVED – MAY TOOL, INC. Staff report dated
  November 23, 2021, was presented recommending authorization of issuance of a
  purchase order to May Tool, Inc., for the purchase of a portable generator, per Quotation
  No. RFQ-0119.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby authorize issuance in a total amount not to exceed
  $52,333. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

178  RESOLUTION NO. 22-18 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-
  2022 ANNUAL BUDGET. Staff report dated November 23, 2021, was presented
  recommending adoption of a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2021-2022 Annual
  Budget for the Purchase of Mobile Date Computers and Related Items.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that Resolution No. 22-18 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE 2021-2022 ANNUAL BUDGET

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

183  CONTRACT AWARDED AND AGREEMENT NO. 22-055 APPROVED –
  KALBAN, INC. Staff report dated November 23, 2021, was presented recommending
  award of a contract and approval of an agreement with Kalban, Inc., to provide
  construction services for the Manchester Boulevard Concrete Improvements Project, per
  Bid No. CB-21-13.

  2
   November 23, 2021

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby award contract and approve Agreement No. 22-055 in a
  total amount not to exceed $743,125 (includes a ten percent (10%) project contingency in
  the amount of $59,450 and a fifteen percent (15%) additional expenditure for additional
  quantities in the amount of $89,175). The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

101 & 131.8  AGREEMENT NO. 22-056 APPROVED -– ACQUISITION AND RESALE OF
  THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 800 GLENWAY DRIVE, #116, INGLEWOOD,
  CA 90302, GENERAL FUND TO PAY THE ACQUISITION AND RESALE
  COSTS ASSOCIATED THERETO - AUTHORIZED; AGREEMENT NO. 22-056B
  APPROVED – AUTHORIZATION AND RESALE OF THE PROPERTY
  ACCORDING TO THE RESIDENTIAL PURCHASE AGREEMENT AND THE
  ASSIGNMENT OF AGREEMENT ADDENDUM DOCUMENTS ATTACHED
  HERETO; CHAIRMAN AUTHORIZED - TO SIGN AND DELIVER ALL
  PERTINENT ACQUISITION AND RESALE DOCUMENTS ASSOCIATED
  WITH THIS TRANSACTION, AS WELL AS NON-SUBSTANTIVE ESCROW
  DOCUMENTS TO ACQUIRE AND RESELL THE PROPERTY; AND CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD’S GENERAL FUND REIMBURSED - ANY ADVANCES
  NECESSARY TO CONSUMMATE THE TRANSACTION. Staff report dated
  November 23, 2021, was presented recommending approval of the acquisition and resale
  of the Property located at 800 Glenway Drive, #116, Inglewood, CA 90302.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve the acquisition of the Property by the
  Inglewood Housing Authority from the seller, Zillow Homes Property Trust, for up to
  $531,300 plus closing costs; 2) Approve the resale of the Property from the Inglewood
  Housing Authority to affordable income household buyer and Homebuyer Assistance
  Program lottery winner, Carmen Mancha, at an affordable resale price of $312,500; and
  3) Authorize the General Fund to pay for the acquisition and resale costs associated
  thereto. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Padilla that the Housing Authority does hereby: 1) Approve the
  acquisition and resale of the Property according to the residential purchase Agreement
  No. 22-056B addendum documents attached hereto; 2) Authorize the Chairman to sign
  and deliver all pertinent acquisition and resale documents associated with this transaction,
  as well as non-substantive escrow documents to acquire and resell the Property; and 3)
  Reimburse the City of Inglewood’s General (General Fund) any advances necessary to
  consummate the transactions. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Chairman Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  126  REPORTS – CITY CLERK. City Clerk, Aisha L. Thompson congratulated the City of
  Inglewood on all of their accomplishments including the Turkey Giveaway with Snoop
  Dogg. She also wished the residents a Happy Thanksgiving.

127.2  COUNCIL INITIATIVE.

  Council Member Dotson:

  CITY SPONSORSHIP APPROVED – 2021 ANNUAL DISTRICT 1 TOY DRIVE
  CELEBRATION. Initiative by Council Member George W. Dotson, requesting
  approval of City Sponsorship of the 2021 Annual District 1 Toy Drive Celebration, to be
  held on December 11, 2021, from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., at the Beat 3 ICOPP Center,
  located at 2901 Manchester Boulevard.

  3
   November 23, 2021

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby approve the City Sponsorship of the 2021 Annual District 1
  Toy Drive Celebration. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

127.2  COUNCIL INITIATIVE.

  Council Member Faulk:

  CITY SPONSORSHIP APPROVED – 2021 ANNUAL DISTRICT 4 HOLIDAY
  DONATION DRIVE. Initiative by Council Member Dionne Faulk, requesting approval
  of City Sponsorship of the 2021 Annual District 4 Holiday Donation Drive, to be held on
  Friday, December 10, 2021, from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., at the Police Community Center
  in District 4, located in Crenshaw Imperial Plaza.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby approve the City Sponsorship of the 2021 Annual
  District 4 Holiday Donation Drive. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City business not
  elsewhere considered on the Agenda.

  Caller (Name Unknown) requested video tapes from the Inglewood Police Department.

  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke on Brown Act Violations, specifically the time limits
  allowed to speak on Agenda Items, and requested a response to her emails and phone
  inquiries.

  Gil Mathieu commented on Agenda Item Nos. H-2 and DR-1, Approval of the
  acquisition and resale of the Property located at 800 Glenway Drive, #116, Inglewood,
  CA 90302.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in memory of Emma Lee Bankson, mother of Airport Commissioner Joan
  Richardson, and James Brown, husband of Carol Raines Brown, at the hour of 2:40 p.m.

  Approved this _____ day of _____________, 2022.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
